notes.title: V1.6.6 New Rule Variants for Rummy, Blackjack, and Others
notes.content:
[h3]Blackjack[/h3]
+ [b]Splitting [/b]can be enabled in the rules

[h3]Twenty-One[/h3]
+ [b]Bugfix[/b]: Dealer rotation every x rounds did not work

[h3]Rummy[/h3]
+ [b]Initial melds[/b] can consist of [b]multiple sets[/b] (configurable)
+ [b]Configurable[/b]: when players can start adding to other players' melds
+ [b]Number of cards[/b] is configurable
+ [b]Card score values[/b] are configurable
+ [b]Additional values for the [b]initial meld minimum are configurable
+ [b]Undo button[/b] to correct the current move
+ [b]Bugfixes[/b] discarding with right mouse button, jokers scoring

[h3]Doppelkopf (Double head)[/h3]
+ [b]Display[/b] indicating which player leads the round

+ Bugfix Autosave function

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33865336/030539acfb060c8b7141f0854fb8d4691cad736e.jpg[/img]

[b]Note[/b]: Savegames from V1.5.4 and older are not compatible with V1.6.1+ and are stored in a separate folder

[h3]V1.6.7 Hotfix[/h3]
+ Bugfix Twenty-One: If the dealer goes bankrupt, another player becomes the dealer
+ Twenty-One: Dealer AI improved
+ Bugfix Gin Rummy: Scoring for Ace, always 1 point
+ Bugfix Rummy: Display of round number in scorecard
+ Bugfix Rummy: Error "Rummy: Overflow Zugbuffer.next[..]"

notes.title: Free Playtest for Classic Card Games 3D (Version 1.5.8)
notes.content:
A playtest for version 1.5.8 of [b]Classic Card Games 3D[/b] is now available. This beta version introduces new rule options:

[list]
[*] [b]Blackjack:[/b] Splitting hands is now possible.
[*] [b]Rummy:[/b] Multiple sets or sequences can be combined during the initial meld to meet the minimum point requirement. Additionally, card values, number of cards, and other rules can be customized.
[/list]
The playtest will be open for a few days and offers a preview of the major update planned for Q1 2025.

notes.title: Skat 3D Premium released!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070770/Skat_3D_Premium][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33865336/77aaffa19b20f43fcc8ed9f72e796c924550c7e1.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070770/Skat_3D_Premium]Skat 3D Premium[/url] is now available[/h1]
The [b]most popular German traditional Card Game Skat[/b] is part of this SP collection - which are new Premium features?

- [b]Multiplaye[/b]r: network game and online game to play in the community, with friends or family
- Animated [b]Tutorial[/b]: Step by step you learn the rules of the game Skat
- More game variants: additional rule variants such as Pub rules
- [b]Higher A.I[/b]. and playing comfort: optimized user interface
- More achievements of Skat
- Several camera perspectives

[h1]About the game[/h1]
Skat is a [b]trick-taking card game[/b] with 3 players very similar to Spades, and [b]national game of Germany[/b]. All popular rule variants and very powerful but adjustable AI opponents are waiting for all who want to play this traditional card game. Game rules can be learned in the animated [b]Tutorial[/b].

Every single round, first the one who plays against 2 others has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning betting and competing, player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but plays against 2 other players!
